sources.snippet: The most notable models in the series currently include: MiniCPM-V 4.6: 🔥🔥🔥 The latest and most efficient model in the MiniCPM-V series. With a total of 1.3B parameters, it surpasses larger models like Gemma4-E2B-it in performance, while showing superior efficiency than smaller models like Qwen3.5-0.8B (achieving ~1.5x token throughput).

sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.6 MiniCPM-V 4.6 is our most edge-deployment-friendly model to date. The model is built based on SigLIP2-400M and the Qwen3.5-0.8B LLM. It inherents the strong single-image, multi-image, and video understanding capabilities of MiniCPM-V family, while significantly improving computation efficiency. sources.title: MiniCPM-V-4.6-gguf: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview MiniCPM-V-4.6-gguf is the GGUF-quantized version of MiniCPM-V 4.6, a multimodal large language model optimized for efficient image and video understanding on edge devices. Built by openbmb, the model combines SigLIP2-400M for vision encoding with Qwen3.5-0.8B as the language backbone.
